_README: SAMPLE LOI clause seed — DUMMY CONTENT ONLY. Body text is placeholder, not real
Starbucks/Oculus language. Mike extracts the real 39 records against THIS SHAPE.
clause -> variant (may pin a selector) -> position -> position_bodies[] / applies_when[]
Key changes from the first sample (proof-of-shape revisions):
- A position carries ONE-OR-MORE bodies via position_bodies[] (one code can emit at
multiple insertion points; each segment is a distinct canonical_body).
- position_kind adds 'conditional_alternative': mutually exclusive, selected by a typed
enumerated selector_value (NOT a rank). CAM0/CAM1/NNN partition building_type.
- NNN is a conditional_alternative (building-type selected) that ALSO emits two segments.
- Chained modifiers (EU2 requires EU1) via applies_when ref_kind 'position_selection'.
- EU1 carries the shared definitions as a second body segment (source-doc defect, noted).
- variant.replaces_base marks Southeast 'replace in entirety' sections.
Keys under `_comment` are documentation; the loader strips them.

selectors.note: PROVISIONAL v1 — confirm values against all clauses during extraction before seeding.

canonical_bodies.body_text: [DUMMY] Tenant pays its proportionate share of CAM {CAM0}, capped at three percent (3%) annual increase.
[DUMMY] FALLBACK FOR SINGLE TENANT BUILDINGS {CAM1}: Tenant pays CAM with no cap, subject to Exhibit C exclusions.
[DUMMY] FALLBACK FOR SINGLE TENANT PARCEL {NNN}: Tenant maintains liability/property insurance; Landlord pays real estate taxes on the single tax parcel; Tenant self-maintains.
[DUMMY] {NNN} Landlord shall provide Tenant the legal description of the separate tax parcel containing the Building (the "Parcel").
[DUMMY] Tenant shall have the exclusive right to sell coffee and espresso-based beverages {EU0}.
[DUMMY] {EU1} and may also sell gourmet, brand-identified coffee and tea.
[DUMMY] "Gourmet" means Arabica-bean-based or sourced from a gourmet coffee/tea brand; "brand identified" means advertised by brand name or served in a brand-identified cup.
[DUMMY] {EU2} and may also sell pre-bottled tea or pre-bottled tea-based drinks.

clauses.title: Common Area Maintenance / Net Charges
clauses.description: CAM recovery — selected by building type, not negotiation rank.
clauses.guidance_note: [DUMMY] CAM0 multi-tenant; CAM1 single-tenant building; NNN single-tenant parcel. NEVER emitted.

variants._comment_selector: This variant is partitioned by building_type v1; the three conditional_alternatives must cover the domain exactly.
variants._comment_replaces_base: Set true on a Southeast variant carrying 'Use from here down / replaces in entirety'.

positions._comment: CONDITIONAL_ALTERNATIVE — multi-tenant. rank NULL, selector_value set. One body segment.
positions.internal_note: [DUMMY] Powder Springs emitted CAM0 at 3% vs national 5% — modified, not word-for-word (audit test case).

positions._comment: CONDITIONAL_ALTERNATIVE — single-tenant parcel. TWO body segments ({NNN} emits at both the CAM block and a premises add-on). Audit says 'NNN word-for-word' iff BOTH segments match.

clauses.title: Exclusive Use
clauses.description: Exclusive-use grant with chained bracket add-ons.
clauses.guidance_note: [DUMMY] EU0 base; EU1 adds gourmet/brand coffee+tea; EU2 adds pre-bottled tea and REQUIRES EU1.

positions._comment: MODIFIER EU1 — additive add-on. Carries TWO segments: the EU1 language AND the shared definitions (which the source doc misplaced inside the EU2 bracket). Defect flagged in internal_note.
positions.internal_note: [DUMMY] SOURCE DEFECT: 'gourmet'/'brand identified' are used in EU1 but defined in the EU2 bracket. Definitions moved to travel with EU1. Raise with Director.

positions._comment: MODIFIER EU2 — additive add-on that REQUIRES EU1. Dependency via applies_when position_selection.

applies_when._comment: position_selection cross-position dependency: EU2 applies only when EU1 is active.
applies_when.note: EU2 grammatically continues EU1 and cannot emit without it.

director_questions.question_text: [DUMMY] The EU 'gourmet'/'brand identified' definitions sit in the EU2 bracket but are used by EU1 — confirm moving them to EU1.

_notes_on_shared_tables: loi_approval_label, loi_config, loi_selector(+domain) are seeded by migrations; selectors here
document the shape for extraction. Confirm the building_type domain against ALL clauses before
seeding — a partial domain becomes a wrong partition later, and post-seed changes are VERSIONED
(bump current_version + re-partition variants), never in-place edits.
